observations: User chose the deterministic QA-only exit fixture instead of an operator kill. Only qa-cursor used forced_failure_mode=anthropic_agent_execution, which selects /bin/false in place of the worker CLI after claim; Claude and the global 0s reap delay stayed unchanged. This validates a nonzero worker exit before service, not SIGKILL or orphaned-worker behavior.

Tester reported a 4:31 start, interpreted as PM CST from the prior timezone confirmation. Relay claimed one QA Cursor request at 22:31:51 UTC, the workspace build succeeded at 22:32:03 UTC, and the Coder agent connected. The reaper observed agent_relay_status done 1 at 22:32:37 UTC; the exact worker process exit time was not observed.

Relay sent a worker-stage retryable failure at 22:32:38 UTC and the Cursor claim-fail metric recorded applied=true. Tester confirmed Cursor displayed the self-hosted pool error with the exact safe retry guidance the Relay sent; the first display time is unknown. The supplied marker was not independently visible in the Relay logs.

Relay queued deletion at 22:32:38 UTC and no QA workspace was visible by 22:32:56 UTC. Original private QA config was restored byte-for-byte; both pools were healthy by 22:33:44 UTC. No manual deletion was needed.
